mechanism: Both agents lower intraocular pressure through different mechanisms (prostaglandin analog vs. beta-blocker), and combined use may result in additive ocular hypotensive effects with potential systemic absorption of timolol.
action: This combination is commonly used clinically for glaucoma management; monitor for excessive IOP reduction and systemic beta-blocker effects (bradycardia, hypotension); separate administration times if possible to minimize systemic absorption.
